subject: general
question: As per the 2011 census, what is the sex ratio of Daman & Diu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**618**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **2011 census**, **the sex ratio in Daman and Diu **stood at** 618 females per 1,000 males**, which is notably lower than the national average of 940 females per 1,000 males.
 
• Among all the union territories, Daman and Diu had the lowest sex ratio in 2011.
 
• In contrast, Haryana exhibited the lowest sex ratio among all the states, with 877 females per 1,000 males. 
 
• As per the 2011 census data, the sex ratio in India was reported to be 943 females per 1,000 males.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Daman and Diu**, a union territory located in western India, comprises two districts: Daman and the Diu island, which are geographically separated by the Arabian Sea.
 
• The coastal town of Daman is traversed by the Daman Ganga River, from which the territory might derive its name.
 
• The term "Diu" is believed to originate from the Sanskrit word "dvipa," signifying "island."
 
• Both Daman and Diu were under Portuguese rule for over 450 years until they were integrated into the Republic of India in 1961.
 
• Daman, situated on the mainland, serves as the administrative headquarters of the union territory.
 
• In contrast, Diu is a small island located to the south of Saurashtra in Gujarat.
